encoder: Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5) builders, one per part (the keel and P1, K2, P2); for each part a Sonnet 5.5 lead ran the verification on both builds, an independent test author (Sonnet 5.5) and an adversarial refuter (Opus)
display_name: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (the GDPR): Articles 2(1)-(2), 4 points (1), (2), (6)-(8), 5 to 11 and 24; Articles 1, 2(3)-(4), 3, 4 points (3)-(5) and (9)-(26); Article 99 is inert machinery; Articles 12 to 23 (Chapter III, the rights of the data subject) (parts: P1, K2, P2)
seat: Two seats: a data subject and a controller (seats for a processor, a data protection officer, a representative and a certification body come with later parts); each asks, on facts it can state, what the Regulation asks of it (assumed, not ruled). There is no seat for an authority.
edition: Regulation (EU) 2016/679, the Publications Office consolidated version of 4.5.2016 (CELEX 02016R0679-20160504), which applies the corrigendum of OJ L 127, 23.5.2018, rendered to plain text by a script; the recitals are reading aids from the as-published text, carried as inert text in recitals/gdpr-recitals.l4 (unstable build only) with the corrigendum's one correction of a recital (71) applied; not the Official Journal text.
not_reviewed: No lawyer or other domain expert has read this encoding against the text, and it has not been checked against the Official Journal. The readings flagged for a lawyer (NOTES.md) are not rulings.

source_text_recitals.note: the as-published text, the only deposited text that has the recitals (the consolidated text has none); read by recitals/gdpr-recitals.l4 only, with the 2018 corrigendum's correction of recital 71 (../../registers/source-bundle/eu-gdpr-2016-679-corrigendum-20180523.txt, sha256 ecbd35fc1fd288d99250db9ad6efc23e925078e04e58dea8c508279175485068)

scope.encoded: P1: Articles 2(1)-(2), 4 points (1), (2), (6)-(8), 5 to 11 and 24; K2: Articles 1, 2(3)-(4), 3, 4 points (3)-(5) and (9)-(26); Article 99 is inert machinery; P2: Articles 12 to 23 (Chapter III, the rights of the data subject); the coverage tables are in NOTES.md and notes/<part>-NOTES.md
scope.inert: as each part's coverage table says
scope.inputs_not_encoded: judgements the text leaves to a person or an authority, and answers of other parts, taken as inputs

checks.note: check.sh with the unstable build and the main build 1.6.112 on the whole folder; both read every module the same; see "Parts of this row" in NOTES.md

checks_unstable_only.note: recitals/ is not read by the folder's check.sh (its glob is $DIR/*.l4, not recursive), because the main build 1.6.112 cannot read the module: it has no hierarchy library and rejects the bullet syntax. Run: L4=<unstable l4> L4_TARGET=unstable ./check.sh recitals, and L4=<unstable l4> python3 -I notes/check-recitals.py (and --self-test, which needs no l4)
